Services.frontendDescription: I build modern, responsive, and scalable web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I can create accessible interfaces, manage complex application state, integrate APIs and authentication flows, optimize performance and SEO, and maintain or modernize existing codebases.
Services.backendDescription: I build APIs and backend services with C#/.NET using microservices and Backend for Frontend (BFF) architectures. I can design and integrate SQL databases, implement authentication and business logic, connect distributed services, and develop solutions with Express.js and Spring Boot.
Services.mobileDescription: I build cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript. I can implement navigation and state management, integrate APIs and native modules, configure deep links, resolve production issues, and improve application performance and stability.

Experience.internshipDescription: During my pre-professional internship at Impulsa Studio, I expanded my frontend development skills by contributing to several websites built with React and Next.js. I helped create pages, update content, and improve responsive interfaces using TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Microsoft Azure. I also used C#/.NET and SQL for backend-related tasks.
Experience.impulsaJuniorDescription: After a year as an intern, I was promoted to continue my work at Impulsa Studio. I handled frontend development for the creation and content updates of websites such as No Hay Sin Suerte and TuCambista. I also contributed to improving the mobile application.
Experience.nttDataJuniorDescription: I joined NTT DATA as a Junior Engineer. I participated in the development and improvement of key features using React Native. I also collaborated on production deployments and coordinated with different technical teams to ensure stable, high-quality releases. This experience allowed me to grow in a demanding corporate environment, strengthen my technical skills, and adapt to large-scale workflows.
Experience.nttDataEngineerDescription: I was promoted to Engineer after demonstrating professional maturity, autonomy, and strong technical capabilities in my previous role. During my involvement in the BCP Mobile Banking project, I contributed to the development of solutions using React Native, took on greater responsibilities within the team, and strengthened my technical judgment in a highly demanding corporate environment. I currently continue contributing to the project, with the goal of becoming a React Native reference within the team.

Projects.projectsIntro: Some projects I have worked on:
Projects.startpageDescription: Tired of messy bookmarks, I created a custom browser start page that provides quick access to my essential links.
Projects.todoDescription: A fully functional Todo App, developed to test and strengthen my skills in both frontend and backend development. On the frontend, I built the application with React, focusing on component modularization, protected route management, and session handling through cookies. On the backend, I designed a basic MVC architecture using Express.js, implementing authentication with JWT and database migrations to simulate a professional production-like environment. This project showcases a functional and scalable application that applies modern web development best practices.
Projects.fastporteDescription: Web application developed as a university project, inspired by ride-hailing platforms like inDrive and Uber.
Projects.rwfLandingDescription: Basic landing page created for my thesis project, RapidWebForge, focused on the validation process and serving as a contact point for web programming students. It also includes links for downloading the desktop application.
Projects.rwfDocsDescription: Documentation for my thesis project, RapidWebForge, showing installation steps and basic usage of the application.
Projects.rwfDescription: Desktop application developed for my thesis project, a low-code tool with a RAD approach for web application generation and web programming learning. The application includes features such as code generation using Babel, connection to local MySQL databases, and local deployment through Nginx.
Projects.nhssDescription: Web application developed for the Peruvian comedian Jorge Luna, designed to manage raffles and promotions with a user base of over 100,000. I contributed to the initial version as an intern, implementing user interface components and core functionalities. Later, as a Junior Software Engineer, I participated in the project's restructuring, developing new features for content management and visualization, as well as introducing design updates and usability improvements.
Projects.nhssContributions: Built reports using SQL. Implemented cookie handling and refresh-token authentication. Developed scalable UI components and features for a large user base
Projects.montaltoDescription: Website developed for the Peruvian law firm Montalto Asociados, focused on showcasing their legal services and facilitating contact with potential clients. This was an independent project where I was asked to implement new sections and add functionalities to optimize the user experience.
Projects.montaltoContributions: Restructured the website by migrating from Create React App to Vite. Implemented a fully responsive design for an optimal experience on mobile devices. Added search functionality to simplify navigation. Introduced multilingual support to improve accessibility and usability. Developed a blog section for relevant and up-to-date content. Built a platform to manage blog posts independently from the main website content
